title: Validity of the encoded Max-Cut graph
statement: Let $E$ be a nonempty finite list of ordered pairs of natural numbers, none of which is a loop. The weighted directed graph formed from $E$ has nonnegative symmetric weights, total ordered-pair weight $1$, and zero diagonal weights.
hypotheses_covered: Every pair in $E$ has distinct coordinates.
